tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// grags pa rin chen gyi zhus lan bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal mchog bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sde snod 'dzin pa grags pa rin chen gyis// ji ltar dri ba byas pa de yi lan// mdo tsam bshad pa 'di la gus par nyon// de la thog mar sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo'am/ mtshan nyid ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du gzhan la gnod pa las ldog pa'i steng du/ sems can thams cad la phan pa bsgrub pa la zhugs pa/ sems pa rgyun chags pa can byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'o// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ 'bras bu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i brtul zhugs la nye bar zhugs pa/ spong ba dang sgrub pa'i sems pa rgyun chags pa can/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin/ lung chos pa'i lugs kyis ngo bo dang mtshan nyid gcig tu 'dod pa lags/ gcig dang tha dad pa'i tshul ni/ nyan thos kyi lugs kyis so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ lus ngag la rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i tshul gyis gnas par 'dod/ theg pa chen po pa'i lugs kyis/ sems la bag chags dge ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par 'dod pa yin pas grub mtha' so so'i rjes su 'brangs nas brtsis na tha dad du 'ong ba yin/ theg pa chen po'i lugs kyis gzhal na/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa nyid kyang sems kyi khyad par gyi chos yin pas gnas pa'i tshe sems kyi ngo bo gcig la bag chags kyi tha dad du phye bar 'dod de/ de nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs su'ang go nyan thos dang theg chen gyi sdom pa gnyis len pa'i tshul ci nas kyang tha dad de/ byang chub sems dpa' dang gsang sngags kyi sdom pa rim gyis pa'i lugs la so sor thob/ cig car 'jug pa la cig car du 'jug pa thob pa'ang yod/ gtong ba'i tshe nyan thos kyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu phal cher gyis byang chub sems dpa' dang*/

rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa mi gtong*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis btang bas/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa mi gtong ba'i skabs kyang srid/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa btang bas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mi gtong ba'i skabs kyang srid pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i dngos gzhi btang bas gsang sngags kyi sdom pa mi gtong mi srid/ byang chub kyi sems las 'das nas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas/ rdo rje spun bsad pa lta bu la mthar thug grub pa'i tshe gsum ka dus gcig tu gtong ba yin/ mang po'i don du mi gcig bsad pa lta bus nyan thos kyi sdom pa btang yang*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis po mi gtong ba'i steng du dge ba yar ldan du 'ong ba yin/ rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang du sbas pa'i rtsa mi 'du ba lags/ yan lag gi rlung lnga 'byung ba lnga'i ngo bo las mi 'da' ba'i phyir/ ngo bo'i cha nas rtsa ba'i rlung las gzhan ma yin/ gnas dang las kyi cha nas so sor bzhag pa yin/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la dril bu pa byed dus/ sngon du slob ma sbyong ba'i cho ga de/ dbang bskur rgyas pa'i sta gon gyi skabs kyi nang gi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga de lta bu byed pa lags/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba la bsre bslad bya ba'i gzhi/ rgyud mtshan nyid pa gcig yod pa'ang srid/ spyir rgyud kha 'thor ba'i lung mang po dang*/ mdo sde'i lung mang po bris 'dug pas thams cad bod kyis byas pa'ang ma yin/ mtshams sbyor dang lhad gcig tu mang po zhugs 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan gyi gtso bo badz+ra dhṛ ka la sogs pa'i sngags kyi btu ba rnams/ rgya gar gyi sbyor tshul rgyus med par bod kyi lugs su byas 'dug gzhan yang tshig gi sbyor ba rags po mang po gda'/ spyir rgyud yang dag pa dang*/ lhad med kyi bka' bstan bcos rnams la 'dris pa byas tsam na/ lhad can rnams skyon can du rjen cher 'ong rgyu cig mchi/ de ltar khyed kyis dris pa'i lan brjod pa'i// dge bas ma lus 'gro ba'i ma rtogs dang*// log rtog the tshom drwa ba rnams bsal nas// shes bya'i gnas la blo gros rgyas gyur cig

/me mo yos bu'i lo/ smin drug gi zla ba'i nyi shu bdun gyi nyin par 'dam gyi sa cha gad skya zhes bya bar/ 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// //'dis bstan pa rin po che dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
